intro.text: 💻 Welcome to the Grand Hackathon! You're a young programmer on a mission to fix bugs, build features, and deploy your app. Are you ready to begin?

rules.text: 📜 Rules: 1) Fix bugs. 2) Make smart choices. 3) Don’t run out of energy. 4) Earn points. 5) Reach the finale with success. Now go!

challenge1.text: 🪲 First bug! Your code throws an error: 'undefined is not a function'. What do you do?

challenge2.text: 🧩 You solved the error. Now your teammate pushes code that breaks your layout. What do you do?

choices.text: Talk to the teammate and resolve it calmly

challenge3.text: 🔐 You reach the login page task. What's your approach?

choices.text: Use a CSS framework for speed

challenge4a.text: 🧪 Looks neat, but the client wants animations. What now?

challenge4b.text: 🌟 Fast and beautiful! Now your timer function is buggy. Choose a fix:

choices.text: Rewrite the timer logic from scratch

final1.text: 🎉 You fixed all bugs and impressed the judges with smooth CSS animations!

final2.text: 🏆 You rewrote the timer, and the app now works flawlessly. You won the Hackathon!

gameover1.text: 💥 Ignoring the error led to a crash in front of the judges. Game Over.

gameover2.text: ⚠️ Overwriting teammate’s code caused a team breakdown. Disqualified.

gameover3.text: 📉 Judges were not impressed with your barebones interface. Game Over.

gameover4.text: ⏱️ Timer never worked again. The app was incomplete. Game Over.
